description:
Pharmacy, in your language.

B.Pharm now has computing and AI in every year: from Python (BP101T) in Semester 1 to Ethical AI in Semester 8. This channel teaches every lesson of the PCI syllabus simply, in English, through prescriptions and real pharmacy examples.

Three short episodes per lesson. Practise the same lesson on our website: voice lessons, Python on your phone, quizzes and unit-wise important questions.

Subscribe so you never miss a lesson.
